Privacy policy

How Everyday Energy handles calculator inputs, analytics, and advertising.

Masukan kalkulator / Calculator inputs

Watts, hours, days, units, rate, and currency are processed in your browser. This site does not transmit, store, or log your entered values on a Vijeron server.

Analitik / Analytics

Google Analytics 4 measures visits and tool-use events. Events include the tool name and page language, not inputs or results. Analytics availability depends on applicable consent choices.

Iklan dan persetujuan / Ads and consent

Google AdSense and Google Funding Choices code may load on content pages. Ad storage, ad personalization, and analytics storage start denied until an applicable consent choice is obtained. Google may process data under its policies; review the consent message when presented.

Kontak / Contact

For privacy questions or corrections, use the Vijeron portal contact page. Do not send unnecessary bill details or personal information.
